transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
I've been feeling extremely depressed and sad for the past year, and I am constantly exhausted. It has become too difficult to handle on my own, so I decided it was time to seek some help.
Have you ever had periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—unusually happy, hyperactive, or needing very little sleep?
No, I have never experienced anything like that. I've only felt this deep, heavy sadness and a complete lack of energy. It has just been a constant low for me.
Have you ever experienced things like hearing voices, seeing things that others can't see, or feeling like people are watching or plotting against you?

Yes, I have... I often hear whispering voices when I'm completely alone, and I've seen dark figures moving in the shadows. I also have this constant, terrifying feeling that I'm being watched and monitored by people I can't see.
Have you ever experienced these whispering voices or feelings of being watched during times when your mood was normal and you were not feeling depressed?

No, I have never experienced those things when my mood was normal. They only seem to happen when I am feeling deeply depressed and completely overwhelmed. When I'm not in this dark place, those voices and feelings aren't there at all.
